create.name: Deanne Bennett
create.bio:
Deanne Bennett is an Australian energy healer and meditation teacher who works with women rebuilding their lives after divorce, separation or betrayal, or after years of putting everyone else first. She draws on her own experience of a marriage that ended in betrayal and on more than twenty-five years of practising Reiki. She is a Reiki Master Teacher, a ThetaHealing practitioner, a chakra healer and a holistic counsellor, and she ran a healing practice called Beaches Healing before founding The Soulful Mentor.

Her main offering is The Sovereign Self-Love Journey, a self-paced online course of 24 audio lessons arranged in three pathways: self-love and self-worth, listening to the body, and a return to feminine sovereignty. Each lesson pairs teaching with a guided meditation and journal prompts, and touches on inner-child work, people-pleasing and boundaries. She also gives away several guided meditations, among them a self-Reiki practice built on the five Reiki principles and a short meditation on remembering one's worth, which she also posts on YouTube and Insight Timer, and she writes a monthly letter and a blog on healing after heartbreak.

courses.title: The Sovereign Self-Love Journey
courses.description: A self-paced online course of 24 audio lessons in three pathways, for women finding their footing after divorce, separation or betrayal. Each lesson combines teaching, a guided meditation and journal prompts on self-worth, the inner child, boundaries and trusting the body. Lifetime access.

free_resources.title: She Remembers She Is Sacred
free_resources.description: A free 12-minute guided meditation for settling the body and remembering one's own worth, with a simple practice to return to whenever you feel yourself drifting. It is sent by email after sign-up.

free_resources.title: Guided Self Reiki Healing
free_resources.description: A free guided self-Reiki session of about 35 minutes that moves through the five Reiki principles and an invocation, then places the hands over the heart, throat, solar plexus, brow and base. Suitable for Reiki students and for first-timers.

free_resources.title: Self Love Shower Meditation
free_resources.description: A free ten-minute guided visualisation in which you rest in an imagined landscape while a gentle rain of loving affirmations washes over you, to soften self-criticism and build self-acceptance.
